title: Non-homogeneous boundary value problems for second-order degenerate hyperbolic equations and their application
summary: We study second-order hyperbolic equations with degenerate elliptic operators and non-homogeneous Dirichlet boundary inputs. We establish existence and regularity of weak solutions in weighted Sobolev spaces under mild assumptions on the degenerate weight. A Dirichlet map is constructed for the degenerate elliptic operator, leading to a solution theory that extends classical approaches to the degenerate setting.
